whatsNew.brushBody: In “Adjust my schedule”, pick “With you” or “With the other parent”, then tap the days. A whole period? The “A period” tool does it in two taps.
whatsNew.repeatBody: “Every Wednesday with the other parent”, “July with you every other year”: add them with “Repeat”, without touching your usual schedule.
whatsNew.summerBody: New choices for school breaks: one month each, alternating weeks, or break by break. Set them in Settings › Custody and holidays.
whatsNew.jumpBody: Tap the month at the top of the calendar, then pick the year, the month or a specific date. No more clicking through arrows to find next summer or next year’s birthday.
